name: o2o_delivery_quick_live_v1
description: Quick Printful POD shipping quote readiness check for o2o delivery. Validates destination + item payload, probes live shipping rate, and returns clear go/no-go with required next fields.

countryCode.description: Destination ISO country code (example: US, KR).

stateCode.description: Destination state/province code. Recommended for US shipments.

items.description: Quote line items. Provide variant_id and quantity for live shipping-rate preview.

mode.description: Optional metadata field. Defaults to o2o.
